translations.web: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
translations.bsb: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
translations.kjv: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
